title: Largest and Smallest Resultant
body: The magnitudes of two displacement vectors are $$A=20\, \text{m}$$ and $$B=6\, \text{m}$$. $$What$$ $$are$$ $$the$$ $$largest$$ $$and$$ $$smallest$$ $$possible$$ $$values$$ $$of$$ $$the$$ $$magnitude$$ $$of$$ $$the$$ $$resultant$$ $$\vec{R}=\vec{A}+\vec{B}$$?
